clause: Native brush engine core + canonical parameters + presets [STU-RAS-023]

scope.summary: Implement ONE native brush engine in studio-engine driving every painting/retouching tool, exposing shared canonical parameters: brush tip/preset, size, hardness, blend mode (StudioBlendMode), opacity, flow, spacing, angle/roundness, pressure and tilt dynamics, and a stroke-smoothing set (0-100 with pulled-string, stroke-catch-up, catch-up-on-end, zoom-adjust). Brush presets saved/reused as named presets; tool presets capture a tool plus its full option configuration. Backend engine + brush-options/preset operator surface.
acceptance_criteria: One brush engine with all canonical parameters
proof_targets: engine stroke composite + preset round-trip runtime
expected_tests: live: a stroke with set size/hardness/flow/spacing/roundness composites the expected pixels through the engine; stroke-smoothing (pulled-string) smooths a jittery input path
live: save a brush preset and a tool preset, reload and confirm identical config
acceptance_criteria_original: one brush engine with all canonical parameters + stroke smoothing modes

target_entries: Studio / Raster / The brush engine, dynamics & presets

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-023]** Studio MUST implement one native brush engine driving every painting and retouching tool. Brush presets MUST be saved and reused as named presets, and tool presets MUST capture a tool plus its full option configuration. This clause is RETAINED IN PART: its statement of a single engine, of named brush presets and of tool presets stands, and its enumeration of the engine's parameters and its "stroke-smoothing 0–100" claim are SUPERSEDED by [STU-RAS-125] through [STU-RAS-136].

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
